name: Samsung Saudi Arabia for Business
note: This is Samsung's B2B/enterprise division; global HQ is South Korea (fails Gate 1 geography) and it sells enterprise solutions, not consumer retail (fails Gate 2). No consumer storefront or domain on file.

name: Alat
note: alat.com is a PIF-owned advanced-industrial and electronics manufacturing company (chips, appliances, devices via manufacturing JVs), not a consumer retailer; the site is a corporate SPA with no store. Manufacturing/industrial, correctly excluded.

name: Bahra Electric
note: Saudi B2B industrial electrical manufacturer (wires, cables, transformers, busways) serving infrastructure and construction projects; corporate site with contact forms and no e-commerce cart. Correctly excluded.

name: Starlink Qatar
note: Misclassified on NAICS. Starlink is Qatar's largest consumer electronics retailer (17+ Starlink Digital stores) with a live e-commerce store at starlink.qa (QAR, working cart/checkout, hundreds of SKUs); HQ Qatar (Ooredoo Group). Batch domain starlinkworld.com is the corporate site, retail runs at starlink.qa.

name: Mitsubishi Electric Saudi Ltd.
note: Global HQ Japan (fails Gate 1); the Saudi entity sells B2B industrial products (elevators/escalators, HVAC, factory automation), not consumer retail. Correctly excluded.

name: aDawliah Electronic Appliances Holding
note: Lazurde pattern. Beyond its B2B professional-AV import arm (adawliah.com), the same Riyadh group runs a live consumer retail e-commerce store at adawliahshop.com (musical instruments and consumer audio, thousands of SKUs, SAR, Tabby, valid CR 2051006970/VAT). Qualifies on the dedicated retail arm; note its old adawliahstore.com is now a hijacked spam domain.

name: Al-Faisaliah Group (JSC)
note: Parent is a mixed holding (agriculture/food, healthcare, food service, electronics), defensibly excluded at parent level. But its subsidiary Modern Electronics runs Sony World (about 20 KSA stores) plus a live consumer e-commerce store at mestores.com (SAR); that retail arm is a real miss and should be evaluated as its own row per Gate 6.

name: Almana & Partners
note: Qatar B2B distributor/wholesaler (FMCG, electronics, appliances, office equipment, warehousing); its only consumer channel, eshop.almanapartners.com, is a 'coming soon' placeholder with no live catalog or cart. No substantial dedicated retail arm; correctly excluded.

name: channels by stc
note: STC's sales and distribution arm. It runs a real consumer retail stream (about 240 outlets) plus an e-commerce site (mystore.com.sa) selling devices, but its primary identity is telecom distribution and it is an STC subsidiary (Gate 6 consolidation). Genuinely ambiguous; flagging the retail/e-commerce stream for separate evaluation.

name: United Matbouli Group
note: Lazurde pattern. UMG is the sole Samsung distributor in KSA and, per multiple sources, the largest distributor AND retailer of consumer electronics/appliances, running roughly 9 to 10 consumer showrooms plus a reported online store at umg.sa (site is live but bot-protected, returns 403). Substantial dedicated retail arm; Jeddah HQ.

name: شركة صقر الجزيرة للصناعة والتجارة والمقاولات
note: Company name and business are industry, trade and contracting (HVAC/refrigeration manufacturing plus contracting). B2B industrial/contracting, not consumer retail. Correctly excluded.

name: Almuftah Group Qatar
note: Parent is a mixed conglomerate (electronics/appliances retail, automotive, furniture, construction, catering, logistics), defensibly excluded at parent level. But its Almuftah Centre division runs a live Qatar department-store e-commerce at almuftahcenter.com (appliances, electronics, cookware, baby, luggage; secure checkout, Qatar-wide delivery, since 1987). That retail arm is a real miss and should be its own row.

name: STC
note: stc.com.sa is a telecom operator (mobile, broadband, enterprise ICT), a services business outside the approved retail categories; consumer device sales are ancillary and are handled via its channels-by-stc arm (flagged separately). Correctly excluded.

name: alfanar Co.
note: alfanar is an electrical-equipment manufacturer (switchgear, wiring devices, lighting) plus EPC/construction and solar energy; products sell through B2B/construction channels with no consumer storefront. Manufacturing/construction, correctly excluded.

name: SAMIR GROUP
note: samirgroup.com is a B2B technology and imaging solutions provider (medical/healthcare imaging, AV integration, industrial NDT, business/digital printing); its mall 'outlets' are photo-printing service shops, not consumer product retail, and there is no consumer e-commerce. Correctly excluded.

name: Lumi | لومي
note: lumirental.com is a Saudi car rental and leasing company, a category explicitly excluded by Gate 2 (automotive rental/leasing). Correctly excluded.

name: Tamweel Aloula
note: tamweel-aloula.com is a consumer finance/leasing company; financial and capital services are explicitly excluded by Gate 2. Correctly excluded.

name: Raqtan
note: raqtan.com supplies commercial/foodservice kitchen equipment and solutions to restaurants and hotels (HORECA), a B2B commercial-equipment model. Correctly excluded.

name: Al-Babtain Power & Telecommunication Co.
note: Al-Babtain (Power & Telecommunication) manufactures power-transmission and telecom infrastructure (poles, towers, lighting columns) for utility and infrastructure clients; B2B industrial manufacturing, not consumer retail. Correctly excluded.

name: ekuep.com
note: ekuep is a B2B e-commerce marketplace for commercial restaurant/cafe/kitchen equipment; despite a working cart, its customers are foodservice businesses, not consumers, and it self-describes as an F&B trade platform. B2B commercial equipment, correctly excluded.

name: Ram Clincs
note: ramclinics.net is a medical and dental clinic chain; healthcare/clinics are explicitly excluded by Gate 2 (retail pharmacy is the only exception, which this is not). Correctly excluded.

name: Creative Closets
note: creativeclosetsme.com is a custom closet/storage manufacturer and installer on a made-to-order project/installation model (housing complexes, hotels, hospitals, airports), not catalog retail; fails Gate 2 (manufacturing/cabinetry-by-project) and Gate 3 (narrow, low-repeat category). Correctly excluded.

name: Saudi Modern Factory For Steel and Wooden Furniture
note: A furniture manufacturing factory (steel and wooden furniture); the domain smf.com.sa does not resolve and no live consumer storefront was found via search. Manufacturing with no live retail channel; correctly excluded.

name: Saudi Company for Development of Construction & Trading Ltd.
note: Name and business are construction development and trading; construction/contracting is excluded by Gate 2 and there is no consumer retail storefront. Correctly excluded.
